'''Hildeborn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the [[Commissioner]] of the [[Iltarr City police]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wukkar/Legends|Wukkar]]. He was known to be good at his job despite taking bribes from [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]].<ref name="Scoundrels" />
